records.previousRemaining: confirm current 2026 legal/procedural effect of older room-rental policy under Omgevingswet
records.finalSweepResult: The legacy Beleidsregel kamerverhuur remains officially published, but uses Wabo/bestemmingsplan terminology. A separate 2026 woningsplitsing policy is explicitly grounded in the Omgevingswet and requires a BOPA. In addition, Huisvestingsverordening Beesel 2026 is council-adopted and effective from 1 July 2026. Therefore the older room-rental policy is retained only as substantive municipal policy evidence; the current procedural permission route must be determined through the Omgevingswet/Omgevingsplan rather than by copying its obsolete Wabo procedure wording.
allowedRemaining: address/activity-specific Omgevingsplan result and dynamically required application materials for ordinary room rental

records.previousRemaining: remaining article-5:2/form fields and annex-III details
records.finalSweepResult: The current Huisvestingsverordening Delft 2023 is positively current from 1 July 2026. Chapter 5 contains the current splitsingsvergunning regime. Article 5:1 ties permit duty to Annex III categories; article 5:2 requires the designated application form and core applicant, representative, address, cadastral, building-year, nature and current-use information. Current 2026 Legesverordening provides the operative fee tiers. The remaining Annex III applicability is building/address category determination rather than unresolved generic law.

use current form for any additional case-specific fields/attachments

records.previousRemaining: current substantive ordinary room-rental rule, especially Binnenstad status; splitting permit evidence/fee
records.finalSweepResult: The current Huisvestingsverordening Doesburg 2024 is in force through 2027, but the official text located in this sweep concerns housing allocation rather than establishing the missing ordinary room-rental conversion regime. The 2026 fee table reserves the Huisvestingswet fee lines for conversion, woningvorming and splitting rather than setting operational amounts, so it is not evidence of a current substantive permit regime. The current municipal house-number/Omgevingsplan route remains valid for actual splitting projects. After repeated official-source searches, no stronger current citywide ordinary-room-rental rule was positively established.
closedOrResolved: 2026 fee table is non-substantive/reserved for conversion/splitting
